findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure random number generation in botocore
 * @description Use of insecure random functions for security-sensitive operations
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-random
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Use of random module for security-sensitive operations
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["randint", "randrange", "choice", "random", "uniform"]).getACall()
select call, "Insecure random function used for potentially security-sensitive operation. Consider using secrets module for cryptographic operations."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure random number generation for security-sensitive operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak cryptographic algorithms in botocore
 * @description Use of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // MD5 usage
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember("md5").getACall()
  or
  // SHA1 usage
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember("sha1").getACall()
  or
  // Weak HMAC algorithms
  exists(API::CallNode hmacCall |
    hmacCall = API::moduleImport("hmac").getMember("new").getACall() and
    call = hmacCall and
    exists(DataFlow::ExprNode digestArg |
      digestArg = hmacCall.getArg(2) and
      digestArg.asExpr().toString() = "\"md5\"" or
      digestArg.asExpr().toString() = "\"sha1\""
    )
  )
select call, "Use of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithm. Consider using stronger algorithms like SHA256 or SHA512."
findings.hypothesis: Weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1) used in security-sensitive operations
